problems.title: Sum of Array Elements
problems.description: Write a function that calculates the sum of all elements in an array of numbers.
problems.context: Array reduction is a common operation in JavaScript. The reduce method is powerful but can be confusing for beginners.
problems.explanation: We use the reduce method which takes a callback with two parameters: the accumulator (acc) and the current element (num). The second argument (0) is the initial value. We add each number to the accumulator, returning the total at the end.

technicalNotes.title: Reduce Method
technicalNotes.description: The reduce() method executes a reducer function on each element, resulting in a single value.

technicalNotes.title: Initial Value
technicalNotes.description: Always provide an initial value for reduce to avoid unexpected results with empty arrays.

hints.text: Think about how you would add numbers on paper - you start with 0 and keep adding each number
The reduce method is perfect for this - it iterates through the array while keeping track of a running total

problems.title: Find Maximum Value
problems.description: Write a function that finds the largest number in an array.
problems.context: Finding the maximum is a classic interview question that can be solved in multiple ways.
problems.explanation: We use the spread operator (...) to pass all array elements as separate arguments to Math.max(). For an empty array, we return undefined.

technicalNotes.title: Spread Operator
technicalNotes.description: The spread operator expands an array into individual elements

hints.text: Consider what should happen with an empty array
Math.max can find the maximum of multiple numbers
